suppress.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-08 against the official Spring advisories and the complete dependency tree/source. This application is servlet Spring MVC with annotated REST controllers and JSON request bodies. It has no XSLT views or view rendering, SSE/view fragments, functional endpoints, WebFlux/Aalto/PartEvent, RSocket, Jetty reactive adapter, WebSocket, user-supplied SpEL evaluation, @ModelAttribute, or user-controlled property-path data binding. The CVEs below are therefore not exploitable in museo-backend 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT. The version-specific PURL and expiry prevent this review from silently applying to a future Spring Framework version.

Reviewed 2026-10-08 against the official Spring Security advisories and the complete dependency tree/source. The application is a stateless OAuth2 resource server validating Keycloak bearer JWTs. It does not include or configure the embedded UnboundID LDAP server, DPoP proof decoding, WebAuthn, HTTP sessions, or a distributed session store. These feature-conditional CVEs are not exploitable. The version-specific PURL and expiry force a new review after any upgrade.
